description:
Tech that takes you places
We’re CarTrawler, the global travel tech company behind seamless connections between people, places and possibilities. From powering car rental to creating smarter ways to move, we make travel smoother for millions worldwide. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration and craic where every idea counts and every journey matters. Ready to make an impact? Let’s go places together.

CarTrawler’s Product & Technology team brings innovation to every journey. Together, our engineers, product managers, designers and analysts use creativity, data and AI innovation to solve challenges that make travel easier for everyone. From building seamless digital experiences to powering smarter automation behind the scenes, we’re shaping a future where technology and people work hand in hand.

Your journey starts here!

Join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract and help shape how CarTrawler serves customers through technology. You’ll help build and evolve our Salesforce Service Cloud platform, Agentforce capability, AI-powered customer experiences and the integrations that connect them to the wider business. From intelligent automation and agent assist to digital channels and the underlying platform, you’ll work across the technology stack that powers our customer contact operation.

You’ll combine hands-on Salesforce engineering with a practical approach to AI, integration and automation. You’ll design solutions that are secure, scalable and measurable, while helping us make thoughtful decisions about where to use Salesforce native capabilities, deterministic automation or AI.
Working within our Customer Contact Technology team, you’ll collaborate closely with Customer Contact, Product & Technology and wider business teams. You’ll have the opportunity to shape an evolving platform and help turn emerging Salesforce and AI capabilities into meaningful improvements for customers and the people who support them.

lists.text: What you’ll do as an AI Engineer (Salesforce & Contact Centre Operations)
lists.content:
• Build and evolve our Salesforce platform: Develop scalable solutions across Service Cloud using Apex, SOQL, Flow and Lightning Web Components, while shaping technical decisions around data models, security, permissions, performance and maintainability.
  • Connect Salesforce to the wider business: Design and own integrations with internal systems and contact-centre technologies using REST APIs, platform events and middleware, building in robust monitoring, error handling, retries and fallback approaches.
  • Build our Agentforce and AI capability: Design, develop and maintain AI agents, agent-assist experiences and intelligent automation, including topics, actions, prompts, grounding, knowledge, guardrails and effective handoffs between AI and people.
  • Develop our Service Cloud and customer channels: Configure and support Service Cloud and Omni-Channel, including routing, queues, skills and presence, while expanding customer experiences across email, chat, messaging, WhatsApp and other digital channels.
  • Make AI and automation work in the real world: Establish testing, monitoring and release practices, evaluate AI and automation performance using operational data and continuously improve experiences based on customer and agent outcomes.
  • Turn business challenges into practical technology: Partner with Customer Contact and wider teams to translate operational needs into scalable solutions, making informed decisions about when to use Salesforce configuration, custom development, deterministic automation or generative AI.
  • Help shape our technology direction: Provide technical guidance to internal teams and external partners, champion strong engineering practices and explore emerging Salesforce and AI capabilities that can deliver meaningful value for our customers and teams.

lists.text: What you’ll bring to the team
lists.content:
• Strong Salesforce engineering experience: Around 5+ years building on the Salesforce platform, with hands-on expertise across Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components and Flow, ideally supported by Salesforce Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep Service Cloud knowledge: Strong experience with Service Cloud and Omni-Channel, including routing and customer contact operations, plus experience supporting digital channels such as email, chat or messaging. Service Cloud Consultant certification would be an advantage.
  • Integration expertise: Proven experience connecting Salesforce with external systems through REST APIs, event-driven architecture and middleware, with an understanding of how to build integrations that remain resilient when things don’t go to plan.
  • Practical AI and Agentforce capability: Experience with Agentforce, generative AI, LLM-based solutions or intelligent automation, with an understanding of prompts, grounding, guardrails, knowledge and human handoff. Relevant Salesforce Agentforce or AI credentials would be a plus, but practical experience matters most.
  • Strong engineering judgement: A solid understanding of Salesforce security, permissions, sharing, identity, data modelling, privacy and auditability, combined with disciplined approaches to testing, releases and maintainable development.
  • A commercial and customer-focused approach to technology: The ability to assess solutions using data and measurable outcomes, and to choose thoughtfully between configuration, custom development, deterministic automation and generative AI rather than reaching for technology for technology’s sake.
  • Curiosity, collaboration and a drive to keep learning: Experience working across multiple teams, systems and technology partners, with the communication skills to turn complex requirements into clear solutions and a genuine interest in how Salesforce and AI are changing the future of customer contact.

text: AI Engineer (Salesforce & Contact Centre Operations) – 12 Month FTC

description:
Tech that takes you places

We’re CarTrawler, the global travel tech company behind seamless connections between people, places and possibilities. From powering car rental to creating smarter ways to move, we make travel smoother for millions worldwide. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration and craic where every idea counts and every journey matters. Ready to make an impact? Let’s go places together.

CarTrawler’s Customer team champions travellers and partners alike. We create experiences that are simple, seamless and human whether supporting customers directly or collaborating with partners to improve every interaction. By listening, analysing and acting with empathy, we ensure that our service not only solves problems but builds lasting loyalty.

Your Journey starts here!

Turn data into insights that make a real difference to our customers and our business. Joining our Customer Insights team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, you’ll take ownership of key reporting and analysis, helping teams understand performance, uncover opportunities and make confident, data-driven decisions. You’ll create intuitive reporting that enables colleagues to explore data independently, while using emerging AI capabilities to make our insights smarter and more proactive. It’s a role with plenty of scope to collaborate, experiment and develop your skills as our approach to analytics and AI continues to evolve.

lists.text: What you’ll do as a Customer Insights Analyst
lists.content:
• Turn data into action by analysing complex datasets and translating your findings into clear, practical insights that improve customer and business performance.
  • Own and evolve key reporting, maintaining and improving dashboards while developing new automated and self-service reporting that helps teams make better decisions.
  • Partner with teams across the business to understand their challenges, define reporting requirements and provide the insights they need to operate effectively.
  • Build confidence with data by sharing your expertise through training and workshops, helping colleagues interpret insights and use data effectively in their day-to-day decision-making.
  • Support forecasting and forward-looking analysis, helping teams move beyond understanding what happened towards identifying what could happen next.
  • Explore the potential of AI, testing emerging technologies and developing AI-enabled insights, alerts and workflows that improve efficiency and support smarter decision-making.

lists.text: What you’ll bring to the team
lists.content:
• 2–3 years’ experience working with data and analytics, with examples of turning analysis into meaningful insights and business outcomes.
  • Strong data analysis skills, including advanced Excel or Google Sheets capabilities and a working knowledge of SQL, alongside the curiosity and confidence to learn new tools.
  • Experience creating clear, engaging data visualisations, ideally using Tableau or a similar reporting and visualisation platform.
  • Confidence working with complex datasets from multiple sources, with an analytical mindset and a structured approach to investigating and solving problems.
  • An interest in AI and automation, with some exposure to generative AI tools or large language models and an appetite to explore how they can improve reporting, analysis and workflows. Experience with Python or R would be a welcome bonus, but isn’t essential.
  • A collaborative and proactive approach, with strong communication skills, the ability to manage competing priorities and an openness to different perspectives and new ideas.

description:
FIXED-TERM CONTRACT

Tech that takes you places 

We’re CarTrawler, the global travel tech company behind seamless connections between people, places and possibilities. From powering car rental to creating smarter ways to move, we make travel smoother for millions worldwide. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration and craic where every idea counts and every journey matters. Ready to make an impact? Let’s go places together.

Now part of Expedia Group B2B, CarTrawler is entering an exciting new chapter, bringing together our deep expertise in car rental, ground transportation and insurtech with Expedia Group’s global scale, technology and extensive travel platform.

The Head of Marketing & Communications is responsible for setting the strategic direction and leading the delivery of CarTrawler’s marketing, brand and external communications agenda, strengthening our market positioning, protecting our corporate reputation and supporting commercial priorities. The role also provides ownership & delivery of CarTrawler’s flagship annual conference, industry events & sponsorships ensuring excellent execution and measurable business value. 

As custodian of the CarTrawler brand, the role will own its positioning, identity and narrative, guiding its evolution and ensuring clarity and consistency across external touchpoints and within a broader corporate brand ecosystem. The role will lead corporate communications and public relations, acting as a trusted adviser to senior leaders on external messaging, media engagement and sensitive or reactive communications matters. 

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, the role is a member of the Commercial Leadership Team and CarTrawler’s Heads of Community. It requires strong strategic judgement, the ability to influence senior stakeholders and the leadership capability to empower a high-performing team.  

Your Journey starts here!

lists.text: What you’ll do as Head of Marketing and Communications:
lists.content:
Marketing and Brand Strategy 

  • Lead the development and execution of CarTrawler’s marketing and brand strategy, aligned with company priorities, partner needs and commercial objectives. 

  • Act as custodian of the CarTrawler brand, owning its strategy, positioning, identity, value proposition and external narrative across key channels and experiences. 

  • Guide brand evolution and alignment within a broader corporate brand ecosystem, collaborating across teams to maintain clear brand governance, consistent messaging and a coherent market presence. 

  • Oversee integrated content, digital marketing and thought leadership programmes that build awareness, strengthen industry credibility and support commercial goals. 

    • Strategic Events, Sponsorships and Brand Activation 

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of CarTrawler’s flagship annual conference, ensuring the team and agency partners deliver an exceptional experience aligned with partner and commercial objectives. 

  • Lead and take overall accountability for the successful delivery of CarTrawler's flagship annual conference, ensuring an exceptional experience aligned with overall objectives through effective leadership of internal teams and agency partners. 

  • Oversee conference content, executive and partner engagement, event delivery risks and post-event evaluation through clear governance, ownership and decision-making. 

  • Direct a focused programme of industry events, sponsorships and brand activations, prioritising opportunities based on strategic relevance, audience engagement and return on investment 

    • Corporate Communications and Reputation 

  • Own and lead CarTrawler's external corporate communications and PR strategy, including proactive media engagement, corporate announcements, partnership communications, executive visibility and corporate reputation management. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for reactive media enquiries and reputational issues, coordinating responses and providing timely, sound counsel on sensitive or business-critical matters. 

  • Advise senior leadership on corporate narrative, messaging, communications risks and opportunities, ensuring an appropriate and consistent external voice. 

  • Build strong working relationships with communications counterparts, PR agencies and relevant external stakeholders to coordinate communications and approvals effectively. 

    • Strategic Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Contribute as a member of the Commercial Leadership Team, bringing strategic marketing and communications expertise to business planning and decision-making. 

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite leaders and senior stakeholders, confidently influencing, challenging and advising on complex priorities. 

  • Partner across Commercial, Business, Product, People and other functions to translate business developments into coherent brand, marketing and communications priorities. 

    • Team Leadership and Operational Excellence 

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing Marketing team, setting clear priorities, empowering ownership and maintaining high standards of quality and accountability. 

  • Oversee marketing budgets, resources, agency partnerships and performance measures, prioritising investment and demonstrating commercial value. 

  • Provide clear direction and sound judgement in a changing environment, ensuring continuity, effective cross-functional collaboration and delivery through others.

lists.text: What you’ll bring to the team:
lists.content:
• 10+ years’ relevant experience in across marketing, strategic events, communications, PR and/or brand leadership.  

  • Proven ownership of large-scale flagship conferences or complex industry events, from strategic concepts and content through to delivery and evaluation. 

  • Proven experience leading corporate communications, media relations and reputation management, including reactive issues and sensitive or high-profile announcements. 

  • Strong strategic brand capability, including positioning, narrative development and governance across multiple channels and complex stakeholder environments. 

  • Demonstrated ability to advise, influence and communicate credibly with C-suite executives and senior leadership teams, exercising discretion and sound commercial judgement. 

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a track record of building, developing and empowering high-performing teams and delivering results through others. 

  • Proven ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving organisational environments, navigating ambiguity, managing competing stakeholder priorities and exercising sound strategic judgement. 

  • Strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management, agency leadership, creativity and attention to detail.

text: Head of Marketing & Communications - Fixed-Term Contract
